summary: Guadalajara, México, software engineer with expertise in Node.js, C/C++, HPC, CUDA, scientific visualization, and a background in genomics and bioinformatics, strong interest in machine learning and statistical inference, advocates for pragmatic approaches in life and work, critical of mainstream tech companies and their practices, engaged in discussions about academic integrity and the politics of science, values community and collaboration, has a history of working on innovative projects, interested in self-hosting and decentralized technologies, has a family structure that includes children, experienced in remote work and open to relocation.
